poetry.0:
Beneath the soil, I lie and wait,
A name erased by hands of fate.
The stars still burn, but not for me,
I sleep beneath eternity.
poetry.1:
The ticking stops, yet time decays,
Within these walls, the silence stays.
A thousand screams behind one door,
What once was life returns no more.
poetry.2:
They sang my name in tongues of dust,
While maggots danced in sacred rust.
My cradle rocked in graves of stone,
With marrow hymns and shrieking bone.
The light withdrew, ashamed to see,
What love became inside of me.
poetry.3:
I stitched my faith from cursed skin,
And drank the dark that bloomed within.
Each heartbeat hums a blasphemed verse,
Of holy rot and sainted curse.
No one shall claim this husk I wear.
I crowned myself in black despair.
poetry.4:
Beneath the veil where shadows creep,
The dead still mutter in their sleep.
I hear them whisper through the seams,
Bleeding sorrow into dreams.
Their hands reach up to drag me down,
And I descend without a crown.
poetry.5:
The altar weeps in crimson tide,
Where once a soul refused to hide.
I offered fear and spoke in moans,
Then cracked my truth through brittle bones.
My future burned, a sick divine,
And now the ruin’s fully mine.
poetry.6:
This skin remembers every scar,
Each whispered sin, each fallen star.
The mirror cracks, but shows me still,
A soul grown sharp enough to kill.
poetry.7:
My breath is smoke, my thoughts are coal,
A shrine of flame where burned the soul.
The night is kind, the light deceives,
I found my truth where no one grieves.
